name: Weight-at-Most-Two Family
definition: The binary class consisting of all supports in $[n]$ of cardinality at most two.
properties: It is a maximum daisy class of VC dimension two and ordering width zero. Its majority closure is the full cube $Q_n$, so its majority completion defect is $2^n-1-n-\binom n2$, which is unbounded with $n$.
